as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-text" value="<font color="#94A3B8">Just like Pac-Man learns to <b>avoid ghosts</b> and <b>collect dots</b> through trial and error, LLMs learn to give Over millions of attempts, the model develops an intuition for what humans find valuable!
